operations.abort: putBelow(bytes32,uint256,uint256) of a stored key with a limit of zero: the guard fails and the call aborts
operations.delete: clear(bytes32) of a stored key: one map write of zero
operations.insert: put(bytes32,uint256) of an absent key: one map write
operations.noop_write: put(bytes32,uint256) of a stored key with the value it has: one map write
operations.overwrite: put(bytes32,uint256) of a stored key with another value: one map write
operations.read_hit: read(bytes32) of a stored key: one map get
operations.read_miss: read(bytes32) of an absent key: one map get

provenance.peak_rss: the resident-set high-water mark of the probe process, started again before each call
provenance.storage: the maps keep their sealed records in files; a commit appends the call's records to a journal and syncs it before the call returns
